subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: To ensure public accountability, transparency, and auditability after concluding complex RFP discussions, the buyer must draft and place which document in the procurement file?
questions.explain: A Memorandum (or Record) of Negotiations provides a documented trail detailing who attended, what was discussed, what concessions were made, and the rationale for the final agreed-upon price and terms.
